confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies a lot with July low-season demand and resort rate swings. Hostel supply in Palm Springs is thin, so the dorm and private-room anchors are less certain. FX value was taken from search result summaries attributed to the RBA, not verified directly on the rba.gov.au page, and the rate date is the 15 October 2026 observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is US desert resort and Southern California tourist-town pricing, similar to Scottsdale and Palm Desert, adjusted for July being a low-demand, very hot season with lower hotel rates. Drink prices are set from typical US resort-town restaurant pricing rather than from beer-ratio logic.
